_readme: Single source of truth for packages. The website cards AND the Yoco checkout function read this file. Prices are in CENTS (R1 = 100). Set pricing to null for quote-only trips. See README.md > Adding packages.

packages.name: Yoco test package - R10 (test only)
packages.summary: A R10 test item used to show Yoco a working online checkout. Not a real trip. Use a Yoco test card while the site is in test mode.
includes: Proves the online checkout works end to end
Pay a R5 deposit or the full R10

packages.name: Kruger self-drive in SANParks rest camps
packages.summary: Campsites, huts, safari tents and bungalows at Skukuza, Satara and Lower Sabie. We check live SANParks availability and book it for you.
includes: Rest camp stay of your choice

packages.name: Greater Kruger tented safari
packages.summary: En-suite tents and bush camps in Timbavati, Manyeleti and Klaserie, with meals and twice-daily game drives.
includes: Meals and game drives as per the lodge

packages.name: Luxury private lodge safari
packages.summary: Sabi Sand, Timbavati and Kapama lodges with all meals, drinks, game drives and guided walks. Ideal for honeymoons and milestone trips.

packages.name: Mpumalanga Panorama Route weekend
packages.summary: God's Window, Blyde River Canyon and Graskop, with a comfortable stay and an easy drive from Gauteng.

packages.name: Zanzibar for two
packages.summary: Beach resort, sunset dhow cruise and Stone Town, with flights from Johannesburg arranged for you.

packages.name: Mozambique beach escape
packages.summary: Ponta do Ouro, Bilene or Vilanculos by road or air. Diving, dolphins and long, slow beach days.

packages.name: Bali or Dubai getaway
packages.summary: Villas and rice terraces in Bali, or city lights and desert evenings in Dubai. Flights, stays and visas handled.

packages.name: Romantic escape close to home
packages.summary: Winelands, mountain and bush hideaways for anniversaries, proposals and babymoons.
